brief.text: Multi-buyer activity was concentrated in Upbound Group (UPBD) and Matador Resources (MTDR), which drew unusually broad participation with seven and six buying insiders, respectively. Autonation (AN) posted the largest cluster total at $1,729,868, while Amusement & Recreation Services saw overlapping cluster purchases in both LUCK ($926,691) and FUN ($294,865). Standing out from the entire board, a single $8,102,077 purchase in Stride, Inc. (LRN) by director Dylan G. Haggart far exceeded the combined value of any listed cluster.
